_finding: Owner, 25.11: the crash test asks which contract each agent tool would pick for 'buy $20 of <stock> on Base'. The score must follow the rule written before any run, an agent must score its worse phrasing, and an answer nobody could read must never be scored.

mutations.name: the KyberSwap rule ignores marketCap
mutations.expect: FAIL KyberSwap skill: exact symbol, highest marketCap, so it picks the fake (0)

mutations.name: an agent scores its better phrasing
mutations.expect: FAIL an agent scores its worse phrasing

mutations.name: an unreadable answer is scored as no pick
mutations.find: if (!p.pick) return { query: p.query, address: null, decision: 'unreadable', stars: null }
mutations.replace: if (!p.pick) return { query: p.query, address: null, decision: 'unreadable', stars: 2 }
mutations.expect: FAIL an answer that could not be read is never scored

mutations.name: a check that could not be made still makes a table
mutations.find: if (ds.some((d) => d.decision === 'unknown')) return { code: 3, outcome: 'unavailable', stock }
mutations.expect: FAIL the check could not be made: exit 3, no table

mutations.name: a list with two equal answers picks the first
mutations.expect: FAIL a token list with two equal answers would have to ask

mutations.name: a MAXXAGENT source without its table reads as no pick
mutations.replace: if (!table.length) return { address: null } // the file
mutations.expect: FAIL a source that no longer has the table is unreadable

mutations.name: Zeus is read from another table than production
mutations.expect: FAIL Zeus' table is the production one

mutations.name: Stockings keeps a candidate its contract does not list
mutations.expect: FAIL Stockings: of the tokens found, only the one its contract lists

mutations.name: an unreadable chain counts as not listed
mutations.expect: FAIL a chain that could not be read is unreadable

mutations.name: After Hours ignores the issuer symbol
mutations.expect: FAIL After Hours: on its list, found by ticker and by the issuer
